WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity,
    (AVG(derived_product_cost) - AVG(derived_total_cost)) / AVG(derived_total_cost) AS relative_gap
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS average_of_invoice_averages
  FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
  ia.invoice_number,
  ia.average_quantity,
  ia.relative_gap,
  ia.average_quantity - oa.average_of_invoice_averages AS quantity_difference
FROM invoice_averages AS ia
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ia.average_quantity > oa.average_of_invoice_averages
ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
